title: Add USB Tethering to dialog Hotspot
line: Phones and other devices connected to a computer as a USB gadget get a USB tethering toggle next to Hotspot, in the Networks widget and in the mobile Hotspot settings.
explanation: Sharing a device's internet connection over USB (the device being the USB peripheral, like a phone running postmarketOS) was only possible by creating a shared wired connection with nmcli; Plasma only offered a Wi-Fi hotspot. The change detects the USB gadget network device (every Linux USB gadget network function reports the driver g_ether) and adds a USB tethering toggle that activates a temporary IPv4-shared wired connection on it, or reuses a shared connection the user already saved for it. The toggle sits next to Hotspot in the Networks widget (icon only with a tooltip, so the search field keeps its width) and on the mobile Hotspot settings page, is only shown when such a device exists, and follows the real state when tethering is started or stopped elsewhere.

commits.message:
applet: add a USB tethering toggle next to the hotspot

On phones and other devices that act as a USB gadget, sharing the
internet connection with the connected computer needed nmcli. Offer a
USB tethering toggle in the applet and in the mobile hotspot settings.

BUG: 468719
